stop_rule: Stop early when NEE_candidate criteria are already satisfied and leave-one-source-out robustness is evaluable.

triggering_source.precoordinate_basis: EuPPollNet pre-classified study 31_Roberts as an island study; the source design declares four rounds per year in 2012 and 2013, 30 minutes and 300 m2 per site-round. Only the three sites with complete 4+4 flower-count schedules were admitted before D1 or phi was opened.

unopened_candidates_at_closure.boundary: Raw interaction-positive dates can reach 6-8 at three sites and effort is 120 minutes / 4000 m2, but the complete outcome-independent sampling frame is not established; no D1 or phi was opened.

Round-like Site_id suffixes exist, but the pinned raw rows did not reconstruct six distinct dated rounds with one date and one effort record per round under the frozen audit; admitted_system_count_before_coordinates = 0. No D1 or phi was opened.
Recovered raw date structure does not yet reconcile with the published source-defined 13-14 rounds/site/year contract. No D1 or phi was opened.
They are not pursued further after stop-early closure and are not reclassified as biological negatives.

post_closure_prohibitions: Do not continue candidate hunting to improve the already passing route metrics.
Do not add Aegean, Ireland, Sicily, Mahé, Giannutri or any later-discovered source to the primary natural-regime plane without reopening the search protocol prospectively for a different analysis.
Do not drop the high-synchrony Roberts systems because they change the route ceiling; their admission was frozen before their coordinates were opened.
Do not redefine Great Britain island status after inspecting its route effect; the source compilation's pre-existing island-study classification is retained.
Do not change any NEE threshold, source weight, time bin, effort rule or partner identity after this closure.
claim_boundary: This closure promotes the combined manuscript to a Nature Ecology & Evolution candidate under the repository's predeclared routing rule. It does not guarantee journal acceptance, establish a universal ecological threshold, or convert natural D1 into synthetic k. The natural placement demonstrates that real island interaction systems occupy a sufficiently broad two-dimensional breadth-synchrony regime plane under the frozen measurement contract, robust to removal of the largest source study.
